state: Validation complete, including the preserved concurrent main update. Resolved fixture failures and the incomplete earlier screenshot journey remain explicitly recorded.
scope: Selective original Three.js appearance and gameplay work. Measured checks establish the stated behavior and rendering observations; they do not establish commercial-game parity, human usability or hardware frame rate.
evidenceIdentity: Source hashes are retained exactly as recorded by each experiment. Experiments occurred at different working-tree states; these hashes are not a claim that every experiment used the final repository state.

referenceReview.verificationScope: Each recovered compressed review file was rehashed and matched against both manifest.json and its assigned individual audit. The original full-resolution source files were not re-downloaded or byte-verified by this consolidation.
referenceReview.originalSourceHashes: Retained provenance only; original full-resolution source bytes were not verified by the compressed-pack review.
referenceReview.corrections: 068 records preservation of existing glazing, not a new transfer. 022 distinguishes runtime wet-contact/tyre-dirt response from optional carried-mud channels currently at zero.
referenceReview.transferScope: All 100 images were individually reviewed; 27 have partial technique transfers. Review completion does not mean every depicted feature was implemented. No reference photographs were copied into the repository.

roadAppearance.evidenceClass: Isolated production road geometry and real WebGL shaders; synthetic fixed lighting/weather presentation on a carved-ground fixture; software GPU.
roadAppearance.method: Production roads on an isolated carved-ground patch, fixed RoomEnvironment and directional/hemisphere lighting. No claim of full-world appearance or hardware performance.
roadAppearance.visualReview: Eight final before/after frames rendered without page/shader errors. Inspected all initial dry/wet town/mountain pairs, the refined Varda dry image, and the final Harbour dry comparison. Harbour camera moved equally to station 119 m to examine a sparse repair near 132 m. Dry wheel-path roughness reduction calibrated down to 0.032 after grazing-light review.
roadAppearance.limits: No full-world appearance or hardware-performance conclusion. The recorded visual review identifies which images were inspected; eight generated final frames do not imply all eight final frames received an additional manual review.

carFinishAppearance.evidenceClass: Isolated actual catalogue geometry and real WebGL shaders; weather, surface water and dirt snapshots held synthetically; software GPU.
carFinishAppearance.method: Isolated actual catalogue car geometry and real WebGL shaders. Synthetic held snapshot weather/dirt values; no worker, gameplay, world or hardware-FPS claim. Same camera, geometry and lighting per before/after pair. Finish controller is the only changed appearance layer.

warnings.message: sigmaRadians, 0.05, is too large and will clip, as it requested 25 samples when the maximum is set to 20

carFinishAppearance.limits: This fixture does not measure natural weather/contact/dirt production, carried-mud behavior with nonzero input, complete-world appearance, driving, or hardware FPS. Garage clone lifecycle is not inferred from these static captures.

spawnLaneRegression.evidenceClass: Headless actual OpenWorldSimulation with ambient traffic and normal controls; no browser, renderer, autopilot or synthetic traffic placement.
spawnLaneRegression.cause: Default eastbound spawn occupied the westbound lane. The first oncoming car could stop nose-to-nose after a prolonged idle boot.

validation.oldSpawnTest: Failed as expected: 1 traffic collision, expected 0.

spawnLaneRegression.limits: A deterministic prolonged-idle spawn regression using this vehicle, seed and traffic setup; not a general collision or human driving study.

scriptedDriftMilestone.evidenceClass: Actual simulation driven through normal controls by an external steering script; assisted evidence, with no renderer.

method.explanation: External scripted steering is assisted evidence even though the raw game result assisted flag is false. No human operator, renderer, forced physical state, injected score, career host or save persistence is used.

goalCalibration.rationale: The beginner playground first milestone is 50 points. The 300/600 mastery goals, all other events and physics/scoring formulas are preserved. This run establishes the first milestone only, not mastery attainability or human usability.

scriptedDriftMilestone.trace: The 232 original 5 Hz trace samples remain in the source document and are not duplicated here.
scriptedDriftMilestone.limits: 69 banked points establish the beginner first milestone after its 100-to-50 target calibration. The 300/600 mastery thresholds, other activities, human usability and manual unassisted completion are not established by this scripted run.

nativeBrowserJourney.evidenceClass: Real FestivalSession, workers, InputController, renderer and native UI paths; software GPU with explicit render submission holds.
nativeBrowserJourney.methodology: Real FestivalSession, workers, InputController and renderer. Natural initial discoveries. GPU submissions held between deliberate rendered states for software-GPU readback; no simulation acceleration. Manual keyboard launch/brake; race completion uses explicitly assisted production autopilot. This is not a hardware performance test.
nativeBrowserJourney.identityLimit: The source journey recorded both identity fields as null; no captured build identity is inferred.

retry.scope: Real session/worker/HUD from an ordinary fresh fixture. Two deliberate abandoned races exercise retry/result identity and disposal; no race completion or human playtest claim.
retry.inputMethod: Normal menu/card buttons and keyboard Escape/Enter. A synthetic MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }) is dispatched on the stale button in the same event task after the trusted keyboard click to test the busy guard. This is not a second trusted input or a recursive HTMLButtonElement.click(). No fixture command/inspect API, fabricated save, physics/pose/state injection or clock acceleration.
retry.renderingMethod: Real low/selected-quality renderer; capture=1&frames=1 holds GPU submissions between explicit session.draw calls. Captures are paused through the real Escape/menu UI. This is not a performance benchmark.

steps.name: fresh real session and natural Harbour discovery
ordinary menu travel, real card and first countdown
resume drains exactly one typed abandoned result and renders results
keyboard retry owns cached travel through worker acknowledgment; stale duplicate is ignored
second cancellation emits one distinct run and preserves the first result
Continue publishes free roam and removes the result dialog
exit removes the HUD and session and releases geometry

retry.driverCorrection: The first focused attempt stopped at a driver assertion because Chromium suppressed recursive HTMLElement.click(). The corrected driver explicitly dispatches a synthetic bubbling/cancelable MouseEvent after the trusted Enter activation. This gesture is labeled synthetic and does not change worker state or physics.
retry.resourceOwnershipNote: The host renderer outlives the disposed session; remaining renderer geometry/textures are not expected to be zero.

layout.evidenceClass: Synthetic DOM/layout samples of the real festival fixture and production CSS, with locally bundled Saira width-variable fonts. No renderer, workers, driving physics, performance, or scene-fidelity claim.
layout.visualInspection: All six final PNGs inspected at the supplied desktop and phone sizes; no actionable clipping, unintended panel overlap or inaccessible result/action label found.

fullWorldMediumNight.evidenceClass: Actual current FestivalSession and workers with the production renderer, Medium quality, EH3, night lighting and rain. A paused fixed-camera inspection, not a driving or hardware-performance measurement.
fullWorldMediumNight.visualReview: Final 1280 x 720 PNG inspected: coherent lit asphalt and paint, road and pavement continuity, resident street detail, visible car and rain, without an actionable new shading or layout defect. The car is partly framed at the right edge; this view does not replace the isolated close-up car comparisons.
fullWorldMediumNight.identityLimit: The capture script recorded no embedded build/source identity. The consolidator records the stable working-tree source hashes for this pass; the complete base commit identifies unchanged dependencies.

reproducer.note: Supply HORIZON_REVIEW_URL for the running local server and HORIZON_REVIEW_EXECUTABLE for an installed Chromium. R2-only candidate density and pace assertions remain disabled.

fullWorldMediumNight.limits: One combined current scene confirms shader compilation and visible integration. The fixture does not expose individual finish-hook binding statistics. Its software render timing is not reported as FPS.

sourceArtifactsNote: Temporary experiment sources are identified for provenance; their relevant results and hashes are retained in this document. Full temporary captures and logs are not repository deliverables.
knownLimits: Commercial reference parity and rebuilt photographed vehicles/environments are not claimed.
No human playtest or target-hardware frame-rate benchmark was run.
The Kestrel physical trial establishes the 50-point introductory goal, not 300/600-point mastery attainability.
Generic worker errors recover through an eight-second command timeout. Timeout reports an uncertain outcome; it does not cancel work already queued in a suspended or slow worker.
The earlier native assisted-race journey ended on a Chromium screenshot error; the separate focused retry/Continue/disposal journey passed.
